title: Apex Legends x Street Fighter 6 Crossover Event, Explained - NewsBreak
text:
By Franz Christian Irorita ,
2 hours ago
Apex Legends and Street Fighter 6 collide in a new crossover event running September 22 through October 13. The event brings a Street Fighter -themed take on Wildcard, a fully remixed Olympus map, and a wave of new cosmetics, alongside free rewards through Twitch and Discord.
Wildcard Gets a Fighting Game Makeover Dropping into Wildcard during the event lets players grab Fighter Gear and choose from four kits based on Ryu, Chun-Li, Akuma, or Dhalsim, each with a Passive, Tactical, and Ultimate tied to that character’s signature moves, from Ryu’s Shin Shoryuken to Akuma’s Shun Goku Satsu.
Collecting tokens scattered around the map fills a Fight Gauge, which unlocks Fighter Form: a third-person camera shift that grants a stronger melee, a block ability, extra damage resistance, bonus speed, and access to that fighter’s full kit. The Fight Gauge ticks down over time, though landing abilities helps refill it before it runs out.
Matches build toward Showdown, the mode’s final round, where every player gets an infinite Fight Gauge and downed or respawning players get thrown straight back into the fight until one squad lands the final KO.
A Remixed Olympus and Eight New Legend Skins Olympus gets a full Street Fighter makeover for the event, including a playable Luke’s Gym built around a Fight Night ring that activates Fighter Form directly, alongside Punch Trucks that drop Fight Gauge tokens when smashed. The map is also dressed up with giant fighter statues, Street Fighter -inspired street art, Blanka-chan balloons, and working arcade cabinets scattered throughout.
Eight new Iconic Skins pair Legends with Street Fighter 6 characters: Sparrow as Ryu, Alter as Chun-Li, Bangalore as Elena, Mirage as Luke, Gibraltar as Akuma, Wattson as Cammy, Caustic as Blanka, and Pathfinder as Dhalsim.
Eight matching Legendary weapon skins cover the R-99, EVA-8, Flatline, Volt, G7 Scout, Mozambique, Devotion, and Peacekeeper, alongside a Hadoken Mythic Universal Melee that comes with its own matching Deathbox, plus Skydive Emotes, Holosprays, Stickers, Badges, Trackers, and Frames.
Free Rewards Through Twitch, Discord, and the Reward Shop Playing matches during the event earns Zenny, a currency that unlocks Reward Shop tiers including a Lifeline x Li-Fen Epic Skin, character banners, trackers, Apex Packs, and crafting metals.
Separately, Twitch Drops run September 22 through 29, rewarding an Insert Coin Here Weapon Charm for anyone who watches an Apex Legends Twitch stream for 60 minutes with their EA account linked.
Similarly, a Discord Quest is also running September 22 through October 12 that hands out a Kung Fu Coach Tracker Set for just 15 minutes of play, provided a player’s Discord and EA accounts are linked ahead of time.
Apex Legends is free-to-play on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via the EA app, Epic Games Store, and Steam. As with all live-service content, EA notes the event’s specifics may shift based on community feedback; EA’s Online Service Updates page covers any changes as they happen.
